description: Wait for a long call to end, instead of sleeping and checking. `job` is the id from a `background: true` call of edit, export or render_ui, or the requestId (or `job:` line) of an edit, also one whose call timed out on your side. Blocks until the job is done or failed and answers its result, the answer the call itself would have given. `running` means your timeout ran out and the job goes on: call wait again. `superseded` means the job ended with an earlier app run or its answer aged out: read the canvas. If this call cannot reach the app at all, the app is down: run scripts/mcp-wait-up.sh.

sessionId.description: Your session id from init: a requestId is per session.

anyOf.description: Seconds to block, default 120, at most 280. 0 answers the state now.

timeout.description: Seconds to block, default 120, at most 280. 0 answers the state now.

name: wait
